description: Implement the identity provider trait (KITH-14he) using personad's SPIFFE Workload API socket. kithd calls FetchJWTSVID on /run/user/{uid}/persona/workload.sock instead of Tailscale WhoIs. The JWT-SVID carries identity, presence level, auth methods, and trust domain provenance (SPEC-HIA). This is the canonical identity provider for kith — Tailscale WhoIs becomes one attestor plugin behind personad rather than a direct integration. Graceful fallback: if personad socket is absent, fall back to Tailscale WhoIs (the current behavior). Requires the identity provider trait (KITH-14he) and personad to exist (SPEC-HIA).
title: Identity provider: personad (SPIFFE Workload API)
